description: This file contains utility function declarations, macro definitions, and constants used for managing WAN applications, system commands, process management, and health checks within a WAN manager project. It primarily provides interfaces for starting, stopping, restarting applications, executing system commands, retrieving system information, and health check operations.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStartApp
methods.description: Starts an application with given name and command line arguments, returns the process ID.

methods.name: WanManager_DoRestartApp
methods.description: Restarts an application with specified name and arguments, returns the process ID.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStopApp
methods.description: Stops a running application identified by its name.

methods.name: WanManager_DoCollectApp
methods.description: Cleans up zombie processes associated with the specified application name.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemAction
methods.description: Executes a system command from the caller.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemActionWithStatus
methods.description: Executes a system command from the caller and returns status.

methods.name: CollectApp
methods.description: Collects zombie processes given a process ID.

methods.name: WanManager_StartIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Starts the IPoE health check application, returns its process ID upon success.

methods.name: WanManager_StopIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Stops the IPoE health check application given its process ID.

methods.name: GetPathToApp
methods.description: Finds and returns the filesystem path of a specified application.

methods.name: WanManager_GetDateAndUptime
methods.description: Retrieves current system date/time and uptime.

methods.name: WanManager_getUpTime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: util_spawnProcess
methods.description: Spawn a new process with specified executable and information.

methods.name: util_terminateProcessForcefully
methods.description: Forcefully terminates a process by PID.

methods.name: util_signalProcess
methods.description: Sends a signal to a process specified by PID.

methods.name: util_getPidByName
methods.description: Retrieves PID(s) for process(es) matching the specified name and arguments.

methods.name: util_getNameByPid
methods.description: Gets the name of a process given its PID.

methods.name: util_collectProcess
methods.description: Collects/waits for a process to terminate, with timeout.

methods.name: util_runCommandInShellBlocking
methods.description: Runs a shell command in blocking mode.

methods.name: WanManager_Util_GetShell_output
methods.description: Reads output from a FILE pointer into a buffer.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetRestartWanInfo
methods.description: Sets restart information related to WAN.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg
methods.description: Updates configuration and triggers restart procedures.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg_Bool
methods.description: Updates boolean configuration and triggers restart.

methods.name: sysctl_iface_set
methods.description: Sets network interface parameters.
